as_told.title: Hippler–Condon letters
as_told.place_text: United States Air Force / Condon Committee

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that letters between the physicist Edward Condon, who led a 1960s government-funded UFO study, and an Air Force colonel named Robert Hippler show that Condon was closely coordinating with the Air Force. Michels tells it as evidence that a study meant to be independent was not.
